checks.description: Frontmatter has exactly name and description, name matches the directory.
checks.rule: YAML frontmatter contains keys name and description only; name equals 'community-engagement' and the description includes trigger phrases.

checks.description: The reply tone is empowering, never deficit-framed, and tied to the strategy angle.
checks.rule: Body sets an empowering, never deficit-framed tone matching brand-voice.md and restates the strategy angle so replies introduce no new message.

checks.description: Reply patterns are given by message type with what not to claim.
checks.rule: Body and template define reply patterns by message type (question, compliment, complaint, pricing or offer, where to start) each with an on-brand shape and what it must not claim.

checks.description: Sensitive or compliance-touching messages escalate to the compliance-privacy-reviewer before any public reply.
checks.rule: Body routes any message touching data collection, PDPL or privacy, accreditation, instructor names, fundraising, roadmap, or unannounced plans to the compliance-privacy-reviewer before replying, and routes distressed messages to a human.

checks.description: A public reply is a gated action; nothing goes out without the human gate.
checks.rule: Body states the guidance never approves a public reply on its own, a reply is a gated action, nothing goes out without the human gate, and silence is not approval.

checks.description: Replies never promise accreditation or mention unannounced plans, and never name instructors without confirmation.
checks.rule: Body bars any reply from promising accreditation, mentioning a roadmap, fundraising, launch date, or unannounced plan, and from naming an instructor without confirmation.

checks.description: No invented Skill Path titles, content lineup, offers, prices, or targets in replies or guidance.
checks.rule: Body forbids inventing a Skill Path title, content lineup, offer, price, or target and instructs stop-and-ask when absent, and bars echoing personal data into a public thread.

checks.description: A usable community engagement guide template exists.
checks.rule: templates/community-engagement-guide.md exists and contains tone, reply_patterns, escalation_rules, and never_say sections.

checks.description: No em dashes, no tatweel, Western numerals only across the skill files.
